sports.note: WTA QFs on 23 Oct came from the official WTA match API; ATP QFs came from the official ATP order-of-play PDFs. WTA rows stamped 23:59 local are the tour's unscheduled placeholder, not a confirmed start time.

EuroLeague and EuroCup games come from the official EuroLeague games API. NBA fixtures come from the committed NBA.com capture of 22 Oct 17:08Z because nba.com returned HTTP 403 to the evening runner; NBA rows carry that capture time.

All seven World Series games are in the official MLB Stats API schedule (24 Oct – 1 Nov). Only Games 1–2 have probable pitchers published; later games are unpriced on the pitcher input but the series total is priced.
NHL schedule and standings are the official NHL API; Liiga fixtures and table are the official Liiga API. Both are machine-readable and were re-read on 22 Oct 2026.
PDC European Championship pairings and seeds are from the official PDC Europe draw page. Start times come from the OLBG listing; the official page confirms the Friday session.
The WST site and its match service returned a JavaScript shell / 'Unauthorized' from the capture runner. No official draw could be read, so no Snooker fixture is published as verified.
Betoro Herreligaen fixtures and table are the official Tophåndbold pages. EHF Champions League and the French/German/Spanish leagues returned JavaScript shells, so their fixtures are not published.
PlusLiga fixtures are verified from the official PlusLiga schedule, but the men's table could not be read (the captured table URL served the women's 2024/25 page), so no line is originated.

Top 14 and Pro D2 fixtures and tables are official LNR pages. URC Round 4 is the official URC fixtures article; the URC table page is a JavaScript shell and the World Rugby ranking page carried news rather than a table, so URC rows are unpriced.

RLWC fixtures are from the official RLWC 2026 draw payload; men's strength uses the IRL World Rankings percentages. The women's IRL table was not rendered in the capture, so women's fixtures are unpriced.

Fixtures are the official Cricket Australia match list. Strength uses the ICC Men's ODI and Men's/Women's T20I annual-update releases (May 2026). Women's ODI rankings were not available, and domestic One-Day Cup matches have no international rating.
Worlds Swiss fixtures and Riot team GPR Elo come from the official lolesports.com schedule page. Every Swiss match in this window is a best-of-one, so only the match-winner market is originated.
The BWF results pages are a JavaScript shell and the match centre did not expose an unauthenticated endpoint to the runner. No official draw could be read.
The WTT event pages returned a 6.4 KB shell and no official draw could be read.
The AFLW fixture page is a JavaScript shell; the official AFL API returned HTTP 403/404. No fixture could be verified.
PGA Tour and DP World Tour pages are leaderboards, not head-to-head fixtures; no match market exists and no official field-strength table could be read from the runner.
Formula 1 and MotoGP publish race entry lists and results rather than match fixtures; no official rating table was readable, so no outright line is originated.
GBGB publishes results and open-race schedules, not a machine-readable fixture feed; no upcoming race could be verified.
